segments.name: Biopharma
segments.evidence: Our Biopharma segment is engaged in the development and commercialization of our pharmaceutical product candidates and is operated from our corporate headquarters in San Antonio, Texas.

segments.name: CDMO
segments.description: Provides contract development and manufacturing services to Tivic and external customers from a San Antonio, Texas facility.
segments.evidence: Our CDMO segment offers contract development and manufacturing services to Tivic and external customers.

revenueModel.text: The CDMO segment earns fees from development and manufacturing services provided to Tivic and external customers, while the Biopharma segment is pre-commercial and generates no product revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: The CDMO provides development services to Tivic to support the manufacturing of Entolimod, the Company's lead product candidate.

changes.text: In December 2025, the Company acquired the manufacturing and development assets of Scorpius Biomanufacturing, establishing Velocity Bioworks as a wholly owned CDMO subsidiary.
changes.evidence: December 2025: Acquisition of the manufacturing and development assets of Scorpius Biomanufacturing, establishing Velocity Bioworks as a wholly owned CDMO subsidiary.

changes.text: In December 2025, the Company ceased sales of its ClearUP sinus device and stopped development of its bioelectronic products, exiting the consumer healthtech business.
changes.evidence: The Company ceased sales of its ClearUP sinus device and related operations as of year-end 2025.
